verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only mentions AMD EXPO overclocking, ECC support (with motherboard), and on-chip 3D V-Cache size, but never states the supported memory type (e.g., DDR5 speed), maximum memory capacity, number of channels, or theoretical bandwidth needed to size memory-bound workloads. This is a fair and expected spec for any CPU vendor page, so absence of the actual numbers makes it 'none' rather than 'na'.
